title: What Reaches the Database?
description: A service receives 50,000 reads/s. A cache serves 95% of them. Ignoring refresh and write work, how many reads/s reach the database?

options.explanation: The miss fraction is 5%; 50,000 × 0.05 = 2,500. A full cache loss would expose the source to 20 times its normal read load.
That is the hit volume served by the cache, not the miss volume sent to the source.
A 5% miss rate is one request in twenty, not one in a thousand.

options.text: Zero reads/s because a cache replaces the database.
options.explanation: Cache misses still require a source, and the database remains authoritative.
